note: H226: opencheck v1 -- self-containment census over every spike.

controls.name: C1_selfcheck_is_two_sided
controls.must_fire_because: a detector that only ever agrees is one nobody can trust; every arm must run and pass in a subprocess
controls.null_must_contain: the arm list and the exit code

arms: ok    A1 a dropped object is FLAGGED
ok    A2 the same digest with its object is NOT flagged
ok    A3 an artifact with no digest produces no rows
ok    A4 a file digest is out of population
ok    A5 a one-entry perturbation does NOT open the digest
ok    A7 a mutated digest recorded under controls/ is NOT reported
ok    A8 publish() output opens, and it refuses to re-hash itself
ok    A9 a resolving opens_at is CITED_VERIFIED, not NO_OPENING
ok    A10 all four ways a pointer can lie are CITATION_BROKEN
ok    A11 a keyed opens_at verifies one digest and does not cover the other
ok    A6 a directory holding a repo root is pruned
ok    F4a G101 opens from its own artifacts
ok    F4b G59 does NOT open from its own artifacts

controls.name: C2_known_positions_hold
controls.must_fire_because: the detector is checked against two spikes whose answer was known before it was written
controls.can_fail_because: G101 stops opening from its own artifacts, or G59 starts

controls.name: C3_narrow_is_a_subset_of_broad
controls.must_fire_because: two lenses that are not nested are two different questions wearing one name
controls.can_fail_because: a row is narrow but not broad

falsifiers.name: F1_blast_radius_is_small_so_wire_the_gate
falsifiers.can_fail_because: <= 3 spikes carry an unopenable published digest
falsifiers.null_must_contain: the spike count and the threshold, so a reader can see which side of it the tree landed on
falsifiers.refutes: that a certify refusal cannot ship this cycle
falsifiers.fires_when: <= 3 spikes carry an unopenable published digest
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_blast_radius_is_large_so_do_not_wire
falsifiers.null_must_contain: both the narrow and broad spike counts
falsifiers.refutes: that the remedy is a gate
